content.content: This layer opens a change inserted after a named position change via `jj new -A <position> -m <summary>` for creation: the position and the summary are given, never defaulted, and the insertion never branches the timeline.
content.rationale: Creation inserts a change at a position; fixing `jj new -A` with an explicit position and the summary as the mechanism keeps birth placement and the summary in one inspectable call that does not branch — no empty-description intermediate for a later step to repair — and gives the --on flag form something to name. The flag spelling stays with the verb; which dependency is the position, and when the set is ambiguous, stays below with S3-new-position.
